maya: FYI ran the AWQ vs GPTQ switch for atlas-13b on staging, seeing a weird quality delta when prefix cache is enabled.
raj: numbers?
maya: baseline GPTQ-int8 (no prefix cache): rougeL 0.422, ppl 9.8. AWQ-int8 (no cache): rougeL 0.419, ppl 10.1 — small gap.
maya: enable prefix cache + continuous batching -> AWQ rougeL drops to 0.404, ppl 11.6. GPTQ with same config stays ~0.421.
sophia: whoa 1.8-2% abs on rougeL for AWQ with cache. Any hypothesis?
liam: could be kv alignment — AWQ quant noise + cache truncation causing token-level drift. Do we have cache key sizes / serialization format?
maya: cache key = prefix hash of first 512 tokens, ttl 30s. Hitrate ~0.72 on our eval set.
olivia: share config pls
maya: ```
model: atlas-13b
quant: awq-int8
batching:
  continuous: true
  max_batch_tokens: 4096
prefetch:
  prefix_cache: true
  ttl_ms: 30000
```
eval-bot: eval summary: GPTQ-int8/no-cache -> rougeL 0.422 | ppl 9.8; AWQ-int8/no-cache -> rougeL 0.419 | ppl 10.1; AWQ-int8/cache+cont-batch -> rougeL 0.404 | ppl 11.6
raj: can you repro locally and dump kv for a failing example?
maya: uploaded trace + kv-dump to s3://redwood-test/atlas-awq-kv/1830001111.tar.gz
liam: sanity check: are we mixing different compute kernels? AWQ runtime toggles fp8 kernels for attention, maybe cache stores fp32 tensors -> mismatch on deserializing.
sophia: good point. prefix cache serialization = float32 by default. AWQ uses compressed scale + int8 indices; deserializing into fp32 without dequantization could shift activations.
maya: quick test idea: force dequantize-on-read or store the raw quant bytes in the cache and see. Can someone try a small patch?
olivia: I'll push a staging patch to force dequantize-on-read and run 1k-sample eval.
infra-bot: patch deployed to staging canary (atlas-13b, awq-int8) on nodes infra-ml-7, infra-ml-9
olivia: quick run results: AWQ/cache+cont-batch w/ dequantize-on-read -> rougeL 0.417 | ppl 10.3. Much closer to GPTQ baseline.
maya: nice. latency impact? continuous batching is required for throughput on Dedicated.
olivia: +3ms p50, +12ms p95 on staging, still within our internal SLA for dev workloads.
raj: proposed next steps: (1) add cache serialization compatibility tests across quant backends, (2) enable automatic dequantize-on-read for AWQ cache entries, (3) run full-bakeoff across conv/qa/summarization evals, (4) hold public rollout until fix lands.
sophia: also add monitoring metric: cache-hit quality delta per model+quant pair (populated in Console).
maya: I'll file a ticket and tag eng-runtime + eng-ml. Thanks all :thumbsup:
liam: ticket id?
maya: RWD-PLT-9237
sophia: great, moving to ops board.
